extraction.name: VQAonline
extraction.description: VQAonline is a visual question answering dataset sourced from online question answering communities. It contains 64,696 examples featuring authentic context, questions, and lengthy answers validated by the individuals asking the questions.
extraction.creator: Chongyan Chen (University of Texas at Austin); Mengchen Liu (Microsoft); Noel Codella (Microsoft); Yunsheng Li (Microsoft); Lu Yuan (Microsoft); Danna Gurari (University of Texas at Austin; University of Colorado Boulder)
extraction.inLanguage: en, es, fr, it, pt, zh, ko, eo, ru
extraction.citeAs: Chongyan Chen, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, and Danna Gurari. Fully Authentic Visual Question Answering Dataset from Online Communities. arXiv:2311.15562v4, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by scraping publicly-available data from the online question-answering platform Stack Exchange, specifically collecting examples containing a natural language question, a natural language context, an image, and at least one answer.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Examples for which the image could not be downloaded from the provided link were removed.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Publicly-available data from the Stack Exchange archive, including 105 topical sites.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For user intent analysis, crowdworkers categorized the primary user intention into 8 categories. For model evaluation, domain experts rated the performance of six model-generated answers per VQA as incorrect, partially correct, or correct.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Amazon Mechanical Turk; home-grown, web-based interface
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: For user intent, two independent workers annotated each instance, and a third worker was hired to break ties if their annotations did not match.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: located in the United States; at least a Master's degree
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The geographic representation of Stack Exchange is unbalanced, with more from countries like US, India, Europe and less from countries like Egypt.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas since VQAs are posted by Stack Exchange users with access to mobile devices and Internet; The geographic representation of Stack Exchange is unbalanced.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset may poorly represent people in poverty-stricken areas since VQAs are posted by Stack Exchange users with access to mobile devices and Internet.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Few-shot learning; Real-world applications including for other community question answering platforms (e.g., Yahoo! Answers, Wiki Answers, Quora), learning assistance VQA tools for children, virtual assistants, visual dialog and query, as well as visual search and browsing.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: We conducted two filtering steps to obtain our final dataset of 64,696 VQAs. First, we removed low-quality VQAs based on Stack Exchange’s feature that enables users to up-vote or down-vote each post (either question or answer). We removed visual questions with scores 0 or less for either the question or answer. Second, we excluded visual questions with multiple images ( e.g., GIF) or with visual answers.
